   corres ((=) \<circ> message_info_map)

         \<and> distinct slots
         \<and> in_user_frame buffer s)
      (\<lambda>s. valid_pspace' s
         \<and> (case ep of Some x \<Rightarrow> ep_at' x s | _ \<Rightarrow> True)
         \<and> (\<forall>x \<in> set (map cte_map slots).
             cte_wp_at' (\<lambda>cte. cteCap cte = NullCap) x s
                   \<and> real_cte_at' x s)

                    cte_wp_at' (\<lambda>cte. cap \<noteq> NullCap \<longrightarrow> cteCap cte \<noteq> cap \<longrightarrow> cteCap cte = maskedAsFull cap cap) slot s)
         \<and> 2 + msg_max_length + n + length caps' < unat max_ipc_words)

item.text: The definitions expose an important dependency cycle to avoid: general finalisation can suspend a thread, while cancellation can delete reply capabilities. I’ve placed restricted fast finalisation and single-cap deletion earlier so they can supply those facts without requiring general finalisation first.

from pathlib import Path
s=Path('/tmp/build_vero_plan.py').read_text().split(\"\\nadd('CorresCombinators'\")[0]
Path('/tmp/append_vero_plan.py').write_text(s+'\\n')
PY

add('AsidPoolObjects',[6,7,17,18],['HeapObjects'], 'Raw ASID-pool read c0006 precedes typed c0007; raw update c0017 precedes c0018. Generic non-TCB update c0131 is available for the setters. Provides pools to ASID lookup and assignment without page-table or VM-root consumers.')
add('PageTableObjects',[8,9,10,11,12,13,14,15,19,20,21,22,23,24,257,142],[], 'PDE/PTE aligned reads precede master-entry reads and their typed wrappers. Whole-directory/table updates precede storePDE/storePTE raw and typed forms; clearing a table c0257 and copying global mappings c0142 reuse entry stores. Isolate low-level page representations from ASID management and invocation decoding.')
add('VSpaceLookup',[4,5,261,262],['AsidPoolObjects'], 'Known-PD ASID lookup c0004 precedes the disjunctive c0005; findPDForASIDAssert c0261 and its continuation rule c0262 follow. This small module is the shared lookup provider for ASID management and architecture decoding.')
add('MappingEntries',[16,275,280,274,256,2,3,30,27,28],['PageTableObjects','VSpaceLookup'], 'Page-table slot lookup, mapped-entry checks, table-mapped query and physical-pointer check precede constructing/checking mapping entries and resolveVAddr. Alignment and page-flush decoding are small consumers of these lookups. Reuse master PDE/PTE access and c0005; avoid importing VM-root switching, flushing or finalisation.')
add('HardwareAsids',[270,269,272,273,285,268,260,266,271,264,281,255],['VSpaceLookup'], 'ASID invalidation and its existential variant precede replacement search; load/store HWASID precede invalidateASIDEntry and getHWASID. TLB invalidation and flushSpace reuse loadHWASID. setCurrentPD and armv_contextSwitch finish the branch. Ordering follows published ARM_H definitions and assertion lookup c0261/c0262, without requiring full VM-root or page-unmap proofs.')
add('VMRoots',[284,283],['HardwareAsids','CapReads','StateFields'], 'setVMRoot uses the TCB vspace cap, ASID lookup and armv_contextSwitch; setVMRootForFlush compares the current root and conditionally switches it. Supplies c0284/c0283 to both scheduler switching and page flushing, without importing either consumer.')
add('VSpaceCleanup',[263,265,258,259,286,287],['VMRoots','MappingEntries'], 'Flush page/table using VM-root switching and HWASID access; delete ASID pool/ASID using flushSpace and invalidateASIDEntry. Then unmap page table/page using slot lookup, pointer checks, stores and flush operations. These resource cleanup correspondences feed architecture finalisation independently of invocation dispatch.')
add('SchedulerSwitch',[146,147,164,154,153,163],['VMRoots','ReadyQueues'], 'Architecture idle/thread switches consume VM-root correspondence. General switchToThread c0164 combines architecture switching, dequeue and current-thread update; guarded variants c0154/c0153 follow, then idle switch c0163. Kept separate from queue mutation so IPC does not depend on the full VSpace branch.')
add('Scheduler',[148,159,158,161],['SchedulerSwitch'], 'chooseThread consumes guarded switches and queue/bitmap facts, then the domain-transition fragment c0159 precedes scheduleChooseNewThread c0158. schedule c0161 composes these with append/enqueue, priority tests and scheduler actions inherited through SchedulerSwitch.')
add('ThreadLifecycle',[244,245,246,180],['FastDelete','CapInsertion','UserRegisters'], 'Restart uses blocked/signal cancellation and single reply-cap deletion locally, reply-master setup, setThreadState and possibleSwitchTo. MCP/priority/domain setters use extended TCB updates and ready-queue operations. Keep these lower than invokeTCB and independent of full scheduling and general capability deletion.')
add('ThreadActivation',[216,217],['ThreadState','UserRegisters'], 'Architecture idle activation and activateThread compose current-thread/state reads with getRestartPC, setNextPC and setThreadState. Activation is independent of invokeTCB and full scheduling; kernel composition imports it alongside schedule.')
add('GeneralFinalise',[61,68],['VSpaceCleanup','FastDelete','UserRegisters'], 'Architecture finaliseCap c0061 reuses ASID deletion and page unmapping. General finaliseCap c0068 then combines that result with endpoint/notification cancellation, unbinding and IRQ/slot facts. Local suspend/cancelIPC reasoning may reuse c0063 and register access; never make FastDelete depend on this module.')
add('RecursiveDelete',[51,33],['GeneralFinalise','CapMovement','CorresCombinators'], 'Special zombie/CNode/thread updateCap c0051 is the update provider for recursive deletion c0033. Use c0068, c0066, c0040 and final-capability queries; spec_corres introduction/elimination c0035/c0038 guide local recursive helpers inside the fixed slot. No new top-level helper declarations or facts from oops slots are assumed.')
add('CNodeDecode',[34],['CapLookup','CapDerivation'], 'decodeCNodeInvocation combines slot resolution, derivation and empty/no-child checks. This decoder does not execute deletion, so keep it independent of RecursiveDelete and CNode execution.')
add('CNodeExecute',[37],['RecursiveDelete','CapInsertion','IpcCancellation'], 'invokeCNode combines cteDelete, move/swap/insert and badged-send cancellation; imported transitive facts cover each branch. Local revoke/rotate reductions may be proved only inside c0037. Decoder facts are not prerequisites for execution correspondence.')
add('Detype',[60],[], 'deleteObjects is a heap/extended-state restriction correspondence with untyped-range invariants. Establish directly from sanitized detype definitions and state relation, not by importing recursive capability deletion: the names refer to different operations. Supplies memory reset and ASID-pool creation.')
add('RetypeObjects',[143,145,250],['PageTableObjects','ThreadObjects','StateFields','CapReads'], 'createObjects-to-createObjects-prime bridge c0143, extended TCB domain initialization c0145 (using c0144/c0150 and extended-object updates), and insertNewCap c0250 supply object creation/retype building blocks. copyGlobalMappings c0142 is imported for architecture object creation. Full untyped execution remains a consumer.')
add('UntypedReset',[252],['Detype','UntypedIndices','IrqPrimitives'], 'resetUntypedCap combines deleteObjects, free-index writes, machine clearing and preemptionPoint. Preserve its nested original Arch context unchanged. This resource reset is isolated from decoding and bulk creation.')
add('UntypedDecode',[249],['CapLookup','CapDerivation','CorresCombinators'], 'decodeUntypedInvocation validates ranges, free space and destination CNode slots; reuse address resolution, empty/no-child checks and conditional error correspondence. No reset or object-creation import is needed to relate the returned invocation.')
add('UntypedExecute',[251],['UntypedReset','RetypeObjects'], 'invokeUntyped composes reset, free-index updates, object creation/extended TCB setup and insertNewCap. c0143 is only an implication bridge, not an unconditional createObjects correspondence; any missing creation helpers must be proved locally in this fixed slot.')
add('AsidPoolExecute',[276,29],['AsidPoolObjects','CapInsertion','Detype'], 'ASID-pool assignment uses pool get/set and cap reads; ASID-control MakePool additionally uses deleteObjects, updateFreeIndex and cteInsert. UntypedIndices is inherited through CapInsertion. Architecture cap-update/creation steps lacking fixed contracts remain local obligations, not assumed correspondence facts.')
add('VSpaceExecute',[277,279,278],['VSpaceCleanup'], 'Page-directory flush, page-table map/unmap and page invocation case analysis reuse VM roots, clearing/store primitives, mapping checks, unmapping and TLB invalidation. Capability field updates in these cases are local obligations; c0051 applies only to zombie/CNode/thread caps and must not be misused here.')
add('ArchDecode',[25],['MappingEntries','CapLookup','CapDerivation','FinaliseSlot'], 'Architecture invocation decoding uses alignment/mapping construction, safe-mapping and flush decoding, ASID/slot lookup, empty-slot validation and final-capability queries. Keeps decoders independent of VSpace execution and general finalisation; missing page-specific decoding helpers can be local.')
add('ArchExecute',[26],['AsidPoolExecute','VSpaceExecute'], 'Architecture performInvocation dispatch composes ASID-control, ASID-pool, page-directory, page-table and page execution correspondences. Imports exactly the two execution branches and does not depend on architecture decoding.')

c0138 lemma entry_corres:

c0139 lemma kernel_corres':
  "corres dc (einvs and (\<lambda>s. event \<noteq> Interrupt \<longrightarrow> ct_running s) and (ct_running or ct_idle)
               and (\<lambda>s. scheduler_action s = resume_cur_thread))
             (invs' and (\<lambda>s. event \<noteq> Interrupt \<longrightarrow> ct_running' s) and (ct_running' or ct_idle') and
              (\<lambda>s. ksSchedulerAction s = ResumeCurrentThread) and
              (\<lambda>s. vs_valid_duplicates' (ksPSpace s)))
             (call_kernel event)
             (do _ \<leftarrow> runExceptT $
                      handleEvent event `~catchError~`
                        (\<lambda>_. withoutPreemption $ do
                               irq <- doMachineOp (getActiveIRQ True);
                               when (isJust irq) $ handleInterrupt (fromJust irq)
                             od);
                 _ \<leftarrow> ThreadDecls_H.schedule;
                 activateThread
              od)"

              (\<lambda>s. ksSchedulerAction s = ResumeCurrentThread) and
              (\<lambda>s. vs_valid_duplicates' (ksPSpace s)))
             (call_kernel event) (callKernel event)"
